Moodle Workplace Pricing

Moodle Workplace is licensed enterprise software, NOT open source, sold only through Moodle Premium Certified Partners and Service Providers. Moodle LMS Core remains free under the GPL.

The single most-misunderstood thing about Moodle

Moodle LMS Core is open source and free under the GPL; you can self-host it forever at zero licence cost (hosting and support are extra). Moodle Workplace is a different product, licensed software, partner-channel only, with no published rate. If you read “Moodle is free” on a comparison site, that statement applies to Core, not Workplace.

The two products

Moodle LMS Core vs Moodle Workplace

ProductLicenceDistributionRate
Moodle LMS CoreGPL v3 open sourceSelf-host or hosted by certified partners$0 licence; hosting and services extra
Moodle WorkplaceProprietary, licensedMoodle Premium Certified Partners onlyNot published; varies by partner
When Core is the answer

If you have the engineering capacity

  • You have ops or platform engineers comfortable running PHP applications.
  • Your training is educational or higher-ed-style; Moodle Core was built for academic use cases first.
  • You want full source-code control, the ability to fork, and an open-plugin ecosystem.
  • You can absorb hosting, backup, upgrade, plugin compatibility testing, and accessibility audit work in-house.
When Workplace is the answer

If you need corporate features without engineering

  • You need multi-tenant organisation hierarchies, workflow approvals, programs and learning plans, automated certifications.
  • You want a partner to own hosting, support, upgrades, and customisations.
  • You are comfortable with partner-channel procurement (no public rate card).
What to ask the partner

Levers a Moodle Workplace partner controls

  • Licence fee structure (per-user, per-tier, flat).
  • Hosting and managed-service line items.
  • Implementation scope and theme customisation hours.
  • Plugin development and ongoing upgrade responsibility.
  • Support tier and SLAs.
